name: Shirakusa Mebae
source: Mebae is a more dominant, extroverted girl.  Her friendly and charming personality is countered by her shrewd antics to create an interesting amalgam.  She’s far more lazy than her younger sister, Ibuki, and often sleeps 10 or more hours just to pass the time.
